title: Quick-Fix Malaysian Molasses Satay
description: Quick-fix Malaysian satay dish featuring molasses and a unique twist on the classic recipe.

ingredients.name: molasses (1/2 cup)
ingredients.amount: heated in a saucepan over low heat
ingredients.notes: to create a sweet and sticky glaze

ingredients.name: cornstarch (2 tablespoons)
ingredients.amount: mixed with a small amount of water to create a slurry

instructions: Thread beef skewers onto bamboo skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Brush the binchotan grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Heat the molasses in a saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Add the cornstarch slurry to the molasses and stir until thickened.
Brush the sesame oil onto the beef skewers.
Place the skewers onto the binchotan grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
Brush the molasses glaze onto the skewers during the last minute of cooking.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with toasted coconut flakes and chopped cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
